title: Transport of compact-support exchange
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $u:T\to U$ a separated finite-type morphism of schemes. Let $v:U'\to U$ be arbitrary and form the Cartesian square with $T'=T\times_UU'$, $w:T'\to T$, $u':T'\to U'$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Supply a compactification $c=(j,p)$ with $j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T$ a quasi-compact open immersion, $p:\overline T\to U$ proper and $pj=u$, and its base change $c'=(j',p')$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. All coefficient sheaves are the constant discrete $\Lambda$-module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use bounded-below input complexes, ordinary uncompleted derived operations and exact open extension by zero.

Write $A_V=\nu_V^*$ for site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $l_a=a_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}$, and $a^*=a_{\mathrm{proet}}^{-1}$. Put $F_u^e=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}j_!^e$, $F_u^p=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}j_!^p$, and similarly for $u'$. Let $C_{c,L}:A_UF_u^eL\xrightarrow{\sim}F_u^pA_TL$ be the normalized proper direct-image comparison followed by the degreewise site comparison for open extension by zero [lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Let $a_v:A_{U'}l_v\cong v^*A_U$ and $a_w:A_{T'}l_w\cong w^*A_T$ be the canonical comparison-pullback isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. Define
$$S_L=v^*(C_{c,L})\circ a_{v,F_u^eL},\qquad T_L=F_{u'}^p(a_{w,L})\circ C_{c',l_wL}.$$
Let $E_u^e:l_vF_u^e\to F_{u'}^el_w$ be the chosen-compactification exchange of [def-cbc-exchange-map]. Let $E_u^p:v^*F_u^p\to F_{u'}^pw^*$ be ambient pro-etale proper unit--square--counit exchange followed by open extension-by-zero base change, i.e. the same chosen-compactification composite as in [def-exchange-projection], with arbitrary $v$. Then for every $L\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$,
$$T_L\circ A_{U'}(E_u^e(L))=E_u^p(A_TL)\circ S_L.$$
This equality is natural in $L$. For an etale-origin witness $(L,\alpha:A_TL\cong N)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], transport along $\alpha$ consequently identifies the transported etale compact-support exchange at $N$ with this specified ambient pro-etale compactification composite. The identification is unchanged under an isomorphism of witnesses. No separatedness of $v$ or of the schemes over a field is assumed.

source.place: Final base-change sentence, expanded at former Step 5: identification of the transported etale exchange with the ambient pro-etale compactification composite.

proof.text:
Write $M=j_!^eL$; it is bounded below because $j_!^e$ is exact and acts degreewise [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below]. Write $\bar w:\overline T'=\overline T\times_UU'\to\overline T$ for the projection of [def-cbc-compact-support-square], so that $(p,p',v,\bar w)$ is a Cartesian square. The proper maps $p,p'$ are of finite type, hence quasi-compact, and separated, hence quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, lem-pc-separated-quasi-separated]; no hypothesis on $v$ is needed. Let $b_p,b_{p'}$ be the counit-mate direct-image comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], natural in their input; they are the normalized comparisons used in $C_{c,L}$ and $C_{c',l_wL}$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange] to $(f,f',g,g')=(p,p',v,\bar w)$ and the input $M$. With $E^e_{*,M}=\operatorname{Ex}_{*,p}(M)$ the etale unit--square--counit exchange of [def-cbc-exchange-map] and $E^p_{*}$ the ambient ringed exchange used in [def-exchange-projection], its equation reads
$$Rp'_{\mathrm{proet},*}(a_{\bar w,M})\circ b_{p',l_{\bar w}M}\circ A_{U'}(E^e_{*,M})=E^p_{*,A_{\overline T}M}\circ v^*(b_{p,M})\circ a_{v,Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}M}.\tag{1}$$
This is an equality of specified morphisms; no invertibility of either exchange is used.

source.place: Lines 4--15: transport the proper direct-image parts by the site comparison.

proof.text:
Let $e_j:A_{\overline T}j_!^e\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!^pA_T$ and $e_{j'}$ be the degreewise derived extensions of the canonical sheaf comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]; these are the open factors of $C_{c,L}$ and $C_{c',l_wL}$. Let $\beta^e_L:l_{\bar w}j_!^eL\xrightarrow{\sim}j'^e_!l_wL$ be the etale open base-change isomorphism of [cor-cbc-derived-extension-zero-base-change] used in [def-cbc-exchange-map], and $\beta^p_N:\bar w^*j_!^pN\xrightarrow{\sim}j'^p_!w^*N$ the pro-etale one of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change] used in [def-exchange-projection], both for the upper open-immersion square $(j,j',\bar w,w)$, with $\bar w$ arbitrary. Apply [lem-fix-site-open-exchange] to this square (its $g,h$ are $\bar w,w$, its $\rho_u$ is $a_u^{-1}$, and its $c_j,e^{\mathrm{et}},e^{\mathrm{proet}}$ are $e_j,\beta^e,\beta^p$). Multiplying its equation on the left by $j'^p_!(a_{w,L})$ and on the right by $a_{\bar w,M}$ gives
$$\beta^p_{A_TL}\circ\bar w^*(e_{j,L})\circ a_{\bar w,M}=j'^p_!(a_{w,L})\circ e_{j',l_wL}\circ A_{\overline T'}(\beta^e_L),\tag{2}$$
natural in $L$.

source.place: Lines 15--19: transport the extension-by-zero factors by the comparisons [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] and [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change].

proof.text:
By definition $E_u^e(L)=Rp'_{\mathrm{et},*}(\beta^e_L)\circ E^e_{*,M}$ [def-cbc-exchange-map] and $E_u^p(N)=Rp'_{\mathrm{proet},*}(\beta^p_N)\circ E^p_{*,j_!^pN}$ [def-exchange-projection]; also $C_{c,L}=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}(e_{j,L})\circ b_{p,M}$, so $S_L=v^*Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}(e_{j,L})\circ v^*(b_{p,M})\circ a_{v,Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}M}$. Write $P'=Rp'_{\mathrm{proet},*}$. Naturality of the mate $E^p_*$ in the morphism $e_{j,L}$, then (1), then (2), then naturality of $b_{p'}$ in $\beta^e_L$ give
$$\begin{aligned}E_u^p(A_TL)\circ S_L&=P'(\beta^p_{A_TL}\circ\bar w^*e_{j,L})\circ E^p_{*,A_{\overline T}M}\circ v^*(b_{p,M})\circ a_{v,Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}M}\\&=P'(\beta^p_{A_TL}\circ\bar w^*e_{j,L}\circ a_{\bar w,M})\circ b_{p',l_{\bar w}M}\circ A_{U'}(E^e_{*,M})\\&=P'(j'^p_!a_{w,L}\circ e_{j',l_wL})\circ P'A_{\overline T'}(\beta^e_L)\circ b_{p',l_{\bar w}M}\circ A_{U'}(E^e_{*,M})\\&=P'(j'^p_!a_{w,L})\circ P'(e_{j',l_wL})\circ b_{p',j'^e_!l_wL}\circ A_{U'}\bigl(Rp'_{\mathrm{et},*}(\beta^e_L)\circ E^e_{*,M}\bigr)\\&=T_L\circ A_{U'}(E_u^e(L)).\end{aligned}$$
The last line is the definition of $T_L$ and $C_{c',l_wL}$. Every factor is natural in $L$, so the equality is natural in $L$.

source.place: Lines 19--20: the transported composite is the pro-etale compact-support exchange map.

proof.text: Let $(L,\alpha:A_TL\xrightarrow{\sim}N)$ be an etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. The transported etale exchange at $N$ is $\Psi_{L,\alpha}=F_{u'}^pw^*(\alpha)\circ T_L\circ A_{U'}(E_u^e(L))\circ S_L^{-1}\circ v^*F_u^p(\alpha)^{-1}$, using that $S_L,T_L$ are composites of the isomorphisms $a_v,a_w$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], $b_p,b_{p'}$ and $e_j,e_{j'}$. By Step 3 the middle part is $E_u^p(A_TL)$, and naturality of the transformation $E_u^p$ applied to $\alpha$ gives $\Psi_{L,\alpha}=E_u^p(N)$. The right side involves no witness, so for any other witness $(L',\alpha')$ of $N$, in particular an isomorphic one, $\Psi_{L',\alpha'}=E_u^p(N)=\Psi_{L,\alpha}$.

split_report.summary: Expanded the blueprint's finite-level transport argument into four proof steps. The proper direct-image exchange is transported using the normalized comparison, the etale-to-pro-etale and pro-etale base-change comparisons identify the open-extension factors, and composing these squares gives the specified compact-support exchange equality; witness transport and invariance follow by naturality. No new nodes were required because every non-elementary ingredient is already stated in the DAG. Maintainer review repair (2026-10-17): Step 2 now cites the open-extension site/base-change coherence lem-fix-site-open-exchange instead of an unsupported naturality claim; Steps 1 and 3 write equations (1), (2) and the full composite calculation; control characters for \bar and \alpha corrected.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the transport proof of thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale.proof.md, lines 4--22: proper direct-image transport, extension-by-zero transport, composition identifying the pro-etale compact-support exchange, and witness independence.

The existing lem-fix-site-open-exchange states it exactly for arbitrary g, so step 2 now cites it as equation (2) and declares it in split_report.tool_uses. It also attributed the equality to full faithfulness; the step now states equation (1) directly from the lemma. Step 3 is now the explicit calculation: naturality of E^p_*, then (1), then (2), then naturality of b_{p'}. I checked each equality.
